path.style: fill: none; stroke: #002060; stroke-width: 4.5; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke: #002060; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke: #002060; stroke-width: 2.5; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke: #94a3b8; stroke-width: 1.8; stroke-linecap: square
fill: none; stroke: #002060; stroke-width: 3.5; stroke-linecap: square

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 23px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: Algorithm 2:

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 20.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Physical Payment HSM Appliance Capacity & Cluster Sizing Engine

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: Input:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Enterprise Banking Endpoints E = { (e_j, tps_j, c_j) } for j = 1, ..., M

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Hardware Sizing Parameters: Alpha_headroom = 0.20 (20%), Cost_unit = $1,200.00 / month

text.style: font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: HSM Physical Capacity: Cap_RSA2048 = 1,200 ops/s/HSM, Cap_MLDSA65 = 180 ops/s/HSM

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: Output:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 17px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Hardware Cluster Sizing Plan H = ( Units_leg, Units_pqc, Deficit_pct, Delta_Cost, Sizing_Verdict )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Compute Aggregate Peak Settlement Volume: TPS_total <- sum( tps_j for j in 1..M )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Apply Enterprise Redundancy & High-Availability Headroom Factor:

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: TPS_effective <- TPS_total * ( 1.0 + Alpha_headroom )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #059669

g.text: // Calculate Required Physical HSM Appliance Units for Legacy vs PQC

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Units_leg <- max( 2, ceil( TPS_effective / Cap_RSA2048 ) ) // N+1 High Availability

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Units_pqc <- max( 2, ceil( TPS_effective / Cap_MLDSA65 ) ) // Due to 85% PQC signing deficit

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #059669

g.text: // Compute Cluster Hardware Deficit Percentage and Cost Delta

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Delta_units <- Units_pqc - Units_leg

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Deficit_pct <- ( Delta_units / Units_leg ) * 100.0 // e.g., +525% Hardware Deficit

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Cost_leg <- Units_leg * Cost_unit // Monthly Amortized Hardware Cost

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Cost_pqc <- Units_pqc * Cost_unit

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: Delta_Cost <- Cost_pqc - Cost_leg

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-style: italic; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #059669

g.text: // Evaluate Static Linear Planning Gap

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: if Deficit_pct > 100.0 then

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #dc2626

g.text: Sizing_Verdict <- CRITICAL_HARDWARE_DEFICIT ( Static IT Linear Sizing Fails )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: else

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #16a34a

g.text: Sizing_Verdict <- COMPLIANT_LINEAR_SCALING

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: end if

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-size: 16.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #0f172a

g.text: H <- ( Units_leg, Units_pqc, Deficit_pct, Delta_Cost, Sizing_Verdict )

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #475569
font-weight: 700; font-size: 16.8px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: return H

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #002060

g.text: Complexity Analysis:

text.style: font-style: italic; font-size: 15.5px; font-family: 'Times New Roman'; text-anchor: start; fill: #334155

g.text: Time Complexity: O(M) over endpoint cluster | Space Complexity: O(1) constant operational registers
